meta.title: Caramávida — The Essence of Nahuelbuta | Ulmo & Tineo Honeys from Chile
meta.description: Premium Ulmo and Tineo honeys from Caramávida, Nahuelbuta mountain range, Chile. Origin, native flora and scientific research. Information for importers and distributors.

hero.lead: Exceptional honeys from the native forests of southern Chile.
hero.statement: A unique territory. An extraordinary flora. Ulmo and Tineo honeys whose singularity we investigate through science.
hero.honeysIntro: Ulmo and Tineo: two native trees, two blossoms, two honeys with a character of their own, harvested in Caramávida, in the Nahuelbuta range.

science.title: Science & Quality
science.intro: We want the singularity of our honeys to be demonstrated, not just described.
science.bioactivityText: In food science, bioactivity refers to the ability of certain compounds to interact with biological systems. In honey, research typically analyses parameters such as phenolic compound content or antioxidant activity in the laboratory. These values depend on each honey's botanical and geographical origin, which is why we measure them rather than assume them.
